description: Choosing which code handles a value, by its shape (`match`), a key (a registry), its class (`singledispatch`) or its own method (polymorphism).
A `match` or `if`/`elif` chain tests its cases in order, so the worst case costs one failed test per case.
A mapping from a key, such as a type tag, to a handler, filled by a registration decorator from any module.
A function that picks its implementation by the class of its first argument; `register` adds or silently replaces one.
What someone does to add a case: register a handler, edit the central `match`, or add a subclass.
A small `match` inside the code of one type that validates and binds each payload version of that type.
